title: S2 · The Names Are Still Up
note: 'Hangar Two after dark... nobody adult is present to tell them what any of it meant.' Sad pool -- the campaign's actual quiet-reflective register, not merely 'thoughtful'. A very faint industrial layer, the same family as Flood Tunnel's, at a fraction of the level: the hall is enormous, dark and empty, and the point is how little is in it.
